title: Selection and Orientation of Reaction-Diffusion Patterns on Anisotropically Growing Domains

contributions.purpose: 证明各向异性域生长可选择并定向 Turing 图案
contributions.mechanism: Gray-Scott 条纹参数下系统扫描各向异性比 α 0.5→1.0(100×100 网格,12000 步)
contributions.evaluation: 随 α 增大由随机取向域转为全局竖条纹对齐;OOP 随 α 单调上升(定性,文中无数值,仅 Fig.4)
contributions.domain: 数学生物学/反应-扩散图案形成
contributions.source_quote: anisotropic domain growth can act as a powerful mechanism for selecting and orienting Turing patterns

contributions.mechanism: 由 2D 功率谱定义 Orientation Order Parameter(OOP=(Pv-Ph)/(Pv+Ph))与角向功率分布 P(θ)
contributions.evaluation: OOP≈0 无序、≈1 竖向;各向异性下 P(θ) 在 ±π/2 出现尖峰
contributions.source_quote: we introduce an Orientation Order Parameter (OOP) derived from the 2D power spectrum

contributions.mechanism: Fourier 空间:x 向拉伸压缩 kx 轴,将 kx≠0 模式推离 Turing 环,只保留 kx=0(竖条纹)
contributions.evaluation: 定性理论论证,无数值验证
contributions.source_quote: anisotropic growth thus acts as a filter on the available Turing modes, selecting only those that are perpendicular to the direction of fastest growth

notes: 非实证类适配问题:纯数值模拟,正文无任何定量结果——所有 OOP/角向功率数值只在图里,文本未给数字。负结果/trade-off:自认 OOP 过渡“non-monotonicity ... complex mode competition”,与干净叙事矛盾且未量化。数据红旗:Introduction 全部引用为未解析的 “[?]”(幻影/断裂引用);Euler Δt=1.0 数值格式粗糙;checklist 复现项自述“code is available in my local condition”(实际未共享代码),且多处 checklist 用“As far as I read the paper, it looks OK”这类审稿口吻敷衍作答。无自声明贡献列表,由 abstract+conclusion 归纳 3 条。desk-reject。
